title: Add read-only AL development plan guidance
summary: BCQuality introduces a provisional read-only contract for enriching AL development plans with applicable constraints through a new skill, extended metadata, and JSON schemas while keeping implementation and delivery to consumer repositories.
key_points: Added new 'al-development-plan' skill requiring a development plan with optional repository context to confirm symbols
Extended skill index and Entry/DO with development-plan, development-guidance-report, and output-aware dispatch metadata
Added JSON schema for report structure and validators for skill discovery, output kind, and path canonicalization
Implementation, tests, persistence, and delivery remain owned by consumer repositories
No changes to plugin version, standalone registration, or stable public API surface; consumer agreement and runtime pilot still pending
quote: Define a provisional, internal, read-only contract for enriching an existing AL development plan with applicable BCQuality constraints.
